title: Finite truncation devissage for module-object complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a commutative ring object in abelian sheaves on its pro-etale site, and P an isomorphism-closed triangulated object property in D(Mod_R). If P contains F[0] for every constructible R-module F, then P contains every bounded complex with constructible homology. Bounded constructibility is also invariant under isomorphisms.

proof.text: Use the proved public constructible_of_iso helper from lem-weil-pbc-module-constructible-pullback to transport constructibility along module isomorphisms. For a derived isomorphism apply this helper to each homologyFunctor.mapIso, and use isomorphism invariance of t.bounded. For devissage set Q(F) := IsConstructibleModuleObject R F and equip Q with isomorphism invariance using the same helper. Apply the existing DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded theorem to P, Q, hP, K, the boundedness component hK.1 and the constructible-homology component hK.2. The generic theorem supplies the finite truncation induction: the zero-length interval is a zero object; the last nonzero truncation is a shifted homology object; the lower truncation has a shorter interval with the same lower homology; closure under shifts and distinguished triangles completes the induction.

proof_origin.note: Repair after the 2026-10-20 upstream sync: restore the quarantined module, replace reliance on the former private constructible_of_iso by the proved public helper from ProEtaleModuleConstructiblePullback, and retain the generic finite-truncation proof and both public signatures.

lemma prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}} [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (P : ObjectProperty
      (DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)))
    [P.IsTriangulated] [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R,
      IsConstructibleModuleObject R F →
      P ((singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))
    {K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)}
    (hK : boundedConstructible R K) : P K
